description: Estimate annual paid leave under the Latvian Labour Law, in calendar days excluding public holidays. Use it to answer how much leave someone has in a year; to find when to take it use latvia_plan_time_off, which counts leave in working days, a different unit. Pass annual_base=28 (the legal minimum) unless the contract grants more, and fte_percentage=1 for full time; part-time work does not shorten leave. birth_date matters only for employees under 18, who get one calendar month. If employment_start_date is on or after 1 January of year, the result is an accrual estimate; the full leave may be requested after six months of work.

annual_base.description: annual leave in calendar days, 28 (the legal minimum) to 60

birth_date.description: YYYY-MM-DD; employees under 18 get one calendar month

fte_percentage.description: working time as a fraction of full time, 0.1 to 1.0 (part-time work does not shorten leave)

name: latvia_leave_entitlement
